# Fixture spec
- **CORE-001** — The client MUST do the first thing.
- **CORE-002** — The server MUST do the second thing.
- **CORE-003** — The client SHOULD do an optional thing.
- **CORE-010** — The client MUST do a thing no test covers.
- Reference only: the client MUST also honour CORE-099 as described elsewhere.
- **CORE-04** — A mistyped id (two digits) MUST NOT count as a rule.
| **CORE-011** | The client MUST define a rule in a table row. |
